case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You pointed to labour and material costs behind your offer, and our options answer that with what your firm values most: a longer contract term for your capacity, at a base price that stays steady for both of us.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd the longest planning horizon, and on quality the record is clear:

Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you do not decide alone on terms like these, please take Option A to the person who does. It is a clear, multi-year arrangement between two family-minded companies, and it is one we are ready to stand behind.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, it is our company policy not to disclose detailed internal cost structures. While we note your comments on quality, our pricing must reflect the current market conditions and our operational standards. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract and can offer €4.90 per unit with 45 days payment terms. Specifically, we can provide a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Option A is the package we can approve. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Since this is a decision beyond your own desk, could you please take Option A to the person who decides at your company? It can be approved as it stands.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are fully authorized to conduct these negotiations and make decisions on behalf of Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Our commitment is always to support your business with our extensive inventory, fast distribution, and reliable technical service.

Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

To confirm an agreement for 45 days payment and a 24-month contract, we require a unit price of €4.89. As an alternative package, we present a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. We have made a further concession to €4.89, which reflects the absolute limit of what we can offer for this package.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You called your latest offer final, and we take that seriously.

Option A is the package we can approve. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

We would be glad to settle this as one simple yes between our two family-run companies, and we would pay every invoice reliably as agreed.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your latest proposal, but as indicated in our previous communication, we have reached the absolute limit of our pricing flexibility. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative package, we can offer a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Consequently, we must formally submit €4.89 for a 24-month contract with 45 days payment terms as our final offer. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We trust you understand that this position is necessary to maintain the high standards of service and inventory you expect from us. Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You have told us that your last offer is final, and we respect that. We accept your alternative package as you proposed it.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 4.89; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

As this is exactly the package you put forward, we can confirm the order straight away once you confirm it to us.

We look forward to continuing our cooperation on this basis.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We are pleased to confirm your acceptance of our final offer at a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Our offer remains valid for 14 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation over the next two years.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure to serve you with our broad range and high-standard service, and we look forward to continuing our great cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
